LvlEndSprCoinsRt.name: Level-end coin sprite and helpers
summary: Sprite routine for the coin that a sprite turns into at the end of a level: a smoke puff while [$1540,X] counts down, then the coin
hops up, falls, awards points ([$18DD] index, +2 per coin, capped at $0D) and erases itself. Scrolls with layer 1 via [$17BD].
$00FC23 (unused): runs Yoshi in from the left edge; $00FC7A: spawns a mounted Yoshi at Mario; $00FCEC: erase all sprites;
$00FCF5: put sprite at (160,0); $00FD08: spawn swimming bubble (finds a free extended sprite slot, falls into s00FD26).

s00FD24.name: Table: bubble X offset by direction

s00FD26.name: Spawn bubble, block smoke puff
summary: $00FD26: creates a water bubble (extended sprite $12) at Mario's mouth: X = Mario X + $02/$0A by direction,
Y = Mario Y + 4 (big, standing) or $0C (small or ducking). Parameters: X = free extended sprite slot.
$00FD5A: spawns a type 5 smoke puff at the block position [$98]/[$9A] (aligned to 16), unless Mario is off-screen; uses layer 2 scroll if [$1933] is set.

s00FDA5.name: Spawn water splash and bubbles
summary: Mario enters water: spawns a water splash (minor extended sprite type 7) on the surface row at Mario's feet, zeroes Mario's
Y speed (and X speed if airborne) unless rising, then fills free extended sprite slots with water bubbles (up to 4, 3 for small Mario).
Quirk: if Mario is not in the air the slot search is skipped and Y is the caller's Y plus 1.

s00FE16.name: Spawn bubble, skid smoke puff
summary: $00FE16: initializes water bubble number Y (extended sprite $12) around Mario using the two offset tables.
$00FE4A: spawns a type 3 smoke puff at Mario's feet every 4th frame while running on the ground; if Down is held it needs some speed.
Returns early if Mario is flying, off-screen or sprites are locked.

s00FE94.name: Table: fireball speed and offsets
summary: FE94: fireball X speed by direction; FE96/FE9C: X offset low/high; FEA2: Y offset. Indexed by direction + 2 per Yoshi state.

ShootFireball.name: Shoot Mario fireball
summary: Finds a free fireball slot (extended sprite slots 8-9) and spawns a Mario fireball (type 5) with Y speed $30 and X speed +-3, positioned
by Mario's direction, Yoshi and [$18DC]. Plays the fireball sound and starts the shoot pose timer [$149C].
Followed by unused routines: $00FF07 (move Mario by layer 1 scroll delta), $00FF32 and $00FF61 (set layer 3 scroll [$22]/[$24] from a sprite position),
then $FF padding and the SNES header and vectors at $00FFC0.
